name: dev.zerodrop/zerodrop-mcp
title: ZeroDrop
description: Disposable email inboxes for AI agents — OTPs and magic links auto-extracted. No signup to try.

environmentVariables.name: ZERODROP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free API key from https://zerodrop.dev/keys. Inbox names then start with your key's prefix, only your key can read them, and the 5-inbox limit doesn't apply to them (your account can receive up to 300 emails a day). Without it, inboxes are public and one sender can reach 5 different inboxes a day.

environmentVariables.name: ZERODROP_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your Workspace's own domain, such as yourcompany-qa.com. Generated inboxes use it; set ZERODROP_API_KEY too.

environmentVariables.name: ZERODROP_BODIES
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to keep email bodies from the agent, even when it passes include_body. Bodies are left out by default either way.
